questions.stem: A quarter of a class scores 80 and the other three quarters score 60. What is the class mean?
questions.explain: Weight each score by its share: (1/4) × 80 + (3/4) × 60 = 20 + 45 = 65.

questions.stem: The mean of 4, 7, x and 5 is 6. What is x?
questions.explain: The total must be 4 × 6 = 24. The other three add to 16, so x = 24 − 16 = 8.

questions.stem: How many different pairs of variables can you pick from 4 variables (order does not matter)?
What is the dot product of (−1, 0, 1) and (−3, 0, 3)?
A pmf has P(X = 1) = 0.2, P(X = 2) = 0.5 and P(X = 3) = p. What is p?
questions.explain: The probabilities add to 1, so p = 1 − 0.2 − 0.5 = 0.3.
